title: Yellowed Pecan Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A romantic Syrian dish featuring tender lamb, crunchy pecans, and a hint of cedar, reduced to be low-fat-friendly. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the chopped pecans over the lamb cubes.
Place the skewers on a cedar plank and grill for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional pecans and lemon wedges if desired.
